description: Web accessibility (WCAG) check — Fetches a public web page (url=, or send html=) and runs a static WCAG 2.2 A/AA accessibility audit of the served HTML: images and image buttons without alt text or with file-name alts, form fields without labels (placeholder-only), buttons and links without accessible names, vague link text (click here, read more), missing page language or title, pinch-zoom disabled, timed meta refresh, skipped heading levels, missing h1/main landmark/skip link, untitled iframes, positive tabindex, aria-hidden focusable elements, role=button or onclick on non-focusable elements, autoplaying audio, video without captions, data tables without headers, broken aria-labelledby/describedby references and missing autocomplete on personal-data fields. Returns MAJOR BARRIERS/NEEDS WORK/MOSTLY ACCESSIBLE with score, grade, issues grouped by rule (WCAG criterion, level, impact, count, examples, fix), page stats and heading outline. JavaScript-rendered content and color contrast are not evaluated. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: web_a11y_check
